title: 决定留在星天  (Choosing to Stay at Xingtian)

segments.t: On the busy studio floor, Lin Jie reminds exhausted Bu Xiaogu that she still has gentler career options, prompting Xiaogu to phone Professor Fang with her final answer on DTS. Listen to their conversation first.
这边的灯光位置都调好了吗？
调好了，林姐。
我听说你是传媒学院的好学生。
节目制作可是非常苦的。
这不比坐办公室那么舒服。
其实你现在还有机会选。
要是觉得太累，别勉强自己。
谢谢林姐，我想清楚了。
喂，方老师，不好意思，我的论文要晚交了。
关于电视台那份工作，我已经决定了。
我要留在星天。
就算从现场组做起，我也要做下去。
Let's unpack what they say. Lin Jie checks the stage setup first and then speaks candidly with Xiaogu.
这边的灯光位置都调好了吗？
'Are the lighting positions over here all adjusted?' Adding "hao" after an action word like "tiao", 'adjust', signals that the job is properly finished, so "tiaohao" means 'adjusted and ready'.
调好了，林姐。
'They are all adjusted, Lin Jie.' Mandarin speakers usually answer yes-or-no questions by echoing the key action chunk "tiaohao le" instead of reaching for a separate word for 'yes'.
我听说你是传媒学院的好学生。
'I heard you are a strong student from Media College.' Leading with "wo tingshuo", literally 'I hear say', introduces secondhand news naturally, and "chuanmei xueyuan" is Media College.
节目制作可是非常苦的。
'Show production is really tough work.' Slipping "keshi" before "feichang ku" adds an emphatic 'mind you, it really is', where "ku" literally means 'bitter' for grueling work.
这不比坐办公室那么舒服。
'This does not compare to sitting comfortably in an office.' Using "bu bi" sets up a negative comparison, and "zuo bangongshi", 'sit in an office', is shorthand for a desk job.
其实你现在还有机会选。
'Actually you still have a chance to choose right now.' Starting with "qishi", 'actually', softens advice, while "haiyou jihui" reassures someone that the door is still open.
要是觉得太累，别勉强自己。
'If it feels too tiring, do not force yourself.' Conversational "yaoshi" means 'if', and "bie mianqiang ziji" warmly tells someone not to push themselves against their will.
谢谢林姐，我想清楚了。
'Thank you, Lin Jie, I have thought it through clearly.' Combining "xiang", 'think', with "qingchu", 'clear', builds "xiang qingchu le" for having made up your mind.
喂，方老师，不好意思，我的论文要晚交了。
'Hello, Professor Fang, sorry, I will hand in my thesis late.' Answering or starting a phone call begins with "wei", and polite "buhaoyisi" apologizes for handing in her "lunwen", 'thesis', late.
关于电视台那份工作，我已经决定了。
'Regarding that job at the television network, I have decided already.' Opening with "guanyu", 'regarding', sets the topic cleanly, and "yijing jueding le" announces a firm decision.
我要留在星天。
'I want to stay at Xingtian.' Short and resolute, "liuzai" joins "liu", 'stay', with "zai", 'at', to name the company she is choosing.
就算从现场组做起，我也要做下去。

'Even starting from the floor crew, I will keep doing it.' Notice the pair "zuoqi", 'start doing from', and "zuoxiaqu", 'keep on doing', framed inside "jiusuan ... ye", 'even if ... still'. Now let us hear the whole conversation once more.
这边的灯光位置都调好了吗？
调好了，林姐。
我听说你是传媒学院的好学生。
节目制作可是非常苦的。
这不比坐办公室那么舒服。
其实你现在还有机会选。
要是觉得太累，别勉强自己。
谢谢林姐，我想清楚了。
喂，方老师，不好意思，我的论文要晚交了。
关于电视台那份工作，我已经决定了。
我要留在星天。
就算从现场组做起，我也要做下去。

Remembering Yuqiao's challenge, Xiaogu turns down the safe DTS offer and commits to proving herself at Xingtian from the ground up. You learned "ku" for tough work, "buhaoyisi" for polite apologies, and "jiusuan ... ye" for 'even if'. See you next time!
再见！
